title: Vallée's control system steps in when a nuke is about to go off

tellings.quote: the the Jacqu fillet control system thing. It knows how to nip at the herd. So like a nuke, you know, is about to go off, it shows up.

plain: The idea is that UFOs act as a kind of control system over humanity, one that "knows how to nip at the herd" and shows up when, say, a nuclear weapon is about to go off. Michels brings it up himself and credits it to the UFO researcher Jacques Vallée. If true, it would mean the phenomenon steps in to steer people at moments of danger.
